scope: Russian AT-84 alphabet, Caps/Shift, punctuation, Ctrl+Alt, controls, keypad and applicable modifier precedence on real IBM AT BIOS. Does not qualify XT-83, legacy reload/rejection, or the full 286 display/NLS matrix.
profile: DOS=LOW, IBM AT 8 MHz 286, AT 84-key keyboard, VGA, 640 KiB conventional and 512 KiB extended RAM
oracle: Existing independent Unicode-to-CP866 and BIOS-word expectations in steps() and modifier_steps(); unavailable right Alt/Ctrl cases excluded and navigation moved to the physical keypad.

driver_corrections.issue: 30 ms spacing could leave Shift held when the probe checked two BIOS ticks after reading the correct Cyrillic byte.
driver_corrections.resolution: Use 10 ms physical event spacing; preserve byte, modifier-release and empty-queue assertions.

driver_corrections.issue: The backend maps XK_KP_Decimal to scan zero, so the guest waits at keypad Delete.
driver_corrections.resolution: Use XK_KP_Delete, mapped by the backend to physical scan 53h.

driver_corrections.issue: TIME_WAIT after clean BIOS-case exit prevented the next port availability check.
driver_corrections.resolution: SO_REUSEADDR permits closed connections while an independently verified live listener still prevents binding.

remaining: Full real-BIOS 286 display font-plane and NLS transition/rejection matrix.
Shell/editor/pipes, Cyrillic filesystem persistence, full release and pristine reproducibility.
